Fully randomizes {c_important}all base{/c} Affixes on a Talisman item.

This does not affect:
{icon:bullet,1.2}  {icon:FontIcon_SetCharm_1,1.5}  Charm Set Bonuses
{icon:bullet,1.2} {icon:uniquestar,2} Charm Unique Powers
{icon:bullet,1.2}  {icon:Talisman_Seal,1.5}  Seal Affixes
{icon:bullet,1.2} {icon:mythicstar,2} Seal Mythic Powers
